head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: API URL download limit hardcoded to 10MB; larger files are silently truncated
description: FileHelper.download for API-provided URLs now uses a fixed 10.megabytes instead of the site settings. Attachments over 10MB, or images when the settings are configured higher, can no longer be fetched. A download failure is swallowed (`rescue nil`), so tempfile is nil and the next line raises NoMethodError.
failurePath: API upload with url to a 15MB file while max_attachment_size_kb is 20MB → download aborted → rescue nil → tempfile nil → file.tempfile/tempfile.size NoMethodError

head: ffbaf8c54269df2ce510de91245760fddce09896
title: Downsize loop ignores failure and runs on the upload path in place
description: The loop ignores the return value of downsize. If convert fails or the file is not a valid image, it runs 5 times in vain, and an oversized file continues on to Upload.create_for. Writing the output over the input path also risks corrupting the upload if convert fails midway. Non-image or animated files with `[0]` frame extraction lose animation when allow_animated_thumbnails is false.

head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19
title: replace('_','-') only replaces first underscore
description: String replace with a string pattern replaces only the first underscore; multi-underscore types won't match ADMIN_MODELS.

head: d1c69189f3c90ecf56013a8da904da9bff9a8e19
title: Host regex rejects valid hosts
description: The regex requires a TLD of 2-5 letters, and doesn't support localhost, IPs or longer TLDs. Also \Z allows a trailing newline.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: unsubscribe_link translation requires unsubscribe_url not always provided
description: The en locale 'unsubscribe_link' now interpolates %{unsubscribe_url}, but template_args only contains it if the caller passes it. Other callers using add_unsubscribe_link (without unsubscribe_url) will raise I18n::MissingInterpolationArgument or output a broken link; other locales lack the key, fine, but the English one is affected.
failurePath: MessageBuilder with add_unsubscribe_link: true and no unsubscribe_url → body/html_part call I18n.t('unsubscribe_link', template_args) → missing interpolation argument
suggestion: Default unsubscribe_url in template_args to user_preferences_url or only include the topic line when present.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: tu.save! bypasses TopicUser.change bookkeeping
description: Direct save skips notifications_changed_at, notifications_reason_id update and the MessageBus publish, so reason remains stale and other open clients are not updated.

head: 6669a2d94d76eea3b99b8c476d12b1eb66726b07
title: Unsubscribe GET is non-idempotent: reloading the page escalates regular to muted
description: A GET endpoint changes notification level immediately. Email link scanners/prefetchers will unsubscribe/mute users without consent. Also repeated loads (reload, refresh) toggle: first regular-or-lower→ muted, and a tracking→regular, so a second visit after first unsubscribe escalates to muted.
failurePath: link scanner or user reload GETs /t/slug/1/unsubscribe → level tracking→regular; second GET → regular→muted
suggestion: GET should show a confirmation; perform change via POST/PUT.

head: 5f8a130277dbddc95d133cd2832be639baf89213
title: Shared array on controller prototype
description: rejectedEmails: Em.A([]) is created once on the class and shared across all instances and persists; pushObject mutates shared state. Should be initialized in init.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: embed.post may be nil or deleted when updating
description: If the embedded post was deleted, embed.post is nil (or trashed) and PostRevisor.new(post) raises NoMethodError on later polls, breaking the whole import loop. Return value of revise! is also unchecked before updating content_sha1.
failurePath: post destroyed → TopicEmbed row remains → next poll with changed content → nil.raw error
suggestion: Guard for post.blank? and only update sha1 when revise! succeeds.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Raw HTML from feeds/remote pages is stored and rendered unsanitized (stored XSS)
description: For cook_method raw_html, cook returns raw with no sanitization. Content comes from external RSS feeds or fetched pages (TopicEmbed.import) and is output via `raw post.cooked` in the embed view and shown in normal topic pages on the Discourse origin. Script tags, event handlers or javascript: links in the feed execute in the forum's origin.
failurePath: attacker-controlled feed or page contains <script>/onerror → PollFeed/import_remote → TopicEmbed.import creates post with cook_method raw_html → cook returns raw → rendered with raw in embed/best and topic view → script runs on the forum origin
suggestion: Sanitize raw_html (e.g. Sanitize gem with a whitelist) before storing/returning it from cook.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Kernel#open on URL fetches server-side without protection (SSRF)
description: open(url) is used with a URL derived from the embed_url request param (only the host is compared to embeddable_host). Redirects to internal addresses are followed by open-uri, and Kernel#open semantic is risky generally. Responses are imported as posts, exposing the content.
failurePath: embeddable host serves a redirect to an internal URL → open follows it → content imported as a post and shown publicly
suggestion: Use Net::HTTP/open-uri via URI.parse(url).open after verifying http(s) scheme, restrict redirects and resolved IPs, add timeouts.

head: 4f8aed295a29954023b2849c060ef4fb299d1b5d
title: Edited applied migration adds force: true, dropping table on rerun
description: Existing migration modified to create_table force: true, which drops an existing top_topics table (and its data) if the migration is rerun; editing history is also unrelated to this feature.
failurePath: migration rerun on environment with data → top_topics dropped and recreated empty
suggestion: Revert the change to this migration.

head: d38c4d5f7443223c81529c22470293771baf9f38
title: Topic map h3 light color changed from 20% to 50%
description: The original color was scale-color($primary, $lightness: 20%). The light branch is now $primary 50%, so the light theme heading becomes lighter than before.

head: 060cda77729cb1c4a827560e09e89a7b22078ba9
title: Public members endpoint now caps non-automatic groups at 50 with no paging in UI
description: The public group members page (group/members.hbs) iterates members from findMembers, which now returns only the first 50. Previously non-automatic groups returned all members. The public template has no pagination, so members beyond 50 are not visible.
failurePath: public group with 120 members → /groups/x/members.json default limit 50 → members.hbs renders only 50

head: ecfa17b5a79dfdc91e7a4d50b42ae78a35d0a293
title: Fallback locales loaded only in the controller
description: ensure_loaded! is only called in set_locale in the controller. Background jobs, mailers, and other code paths that set I18n.locale (e.g. with_locale) do not load fallback locales, so fallbacks (en) are missing there, producing 'translation missing'.

head: ecfa17b5a79dfdc91e7a4d50b42ae78a35d0a293
title: Fallback locales not loaded outside controllers; 'translation missing' can be cached
description: translate only lazy-loads config.locale. Fallback locales (site default, :en) are loaded only by ApplicationController#set_locale via ensure_loaded!. In Sidekiq jobs, mailers, rake tasks or other entry points that set I18n.locale without going through a controller, a key missing in the current locale falls back to locales that are not loaded, so the lookup yields 'translation missing' and that string is frozen into the LRU cache under the locale key. It is then served to later requests too.
failurePath: job sets I18n.with_locale(:fr) → I18n.t('some.key') missing in fr → fallback :en never loaded → 'translation missing: ...' cached for fr → controller requests later get that string
suggestion: Call I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! (or load fallback locales) inside translate/load_locale, and don't cache missing-translation results.

head: 8ab88145113dd23a930e23b9cbbcf8b30e4c0b17
title: Missing end_timestamp_precise raises KeyError in the batch
description: val["end_timestamp_precise"] is accessed unguarded; any span lacking it raises KeyError and crashes the whole batch processing, blocking the consumer on a poison message.
failurePath: span without end_timestamp_precise → KeyError in process_batch → consumer crash loop
suggestion: Use val.get with a fallback or skip invalid spans.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: Only exact 'count()' is transformed
description: Other aggregates (count_unique, eps, epm, etc.) are not upsampled and yAxis with multiple columns mixes upsampled and raw counts; also sample_weight is assumed to exist for all events though events without a sample rate would sum NULL/0, yielding zero counts.

head: 6ad6fe3899f630ccf922ce7ac681147dc7987435
title: upsampled_count sums sample_weight, which is NULL for events without a client sample rate
description: upsampled_count is sum(sample_weight) with no fallback. Events in allowlisted projects that carry no sample_weight (unsampled events, older events) contribute nothing, so the chart count undercounts, and can be 0. The code comment assumes the column is always populated, but nothing enforces that.
failurePath: allowlisted project with events lacking sample_rate → count() rewritten to upsampled_count() → sum(sample_weight) ignores NULLs → count shown as 0 or too low
suggestion: Use sum(coalesce(sample_weight, 1)) or toInt64(round(sum(...))) with a fallback of 1.

head: ea188e2d736fd6ed27c1dba8aae63b7268e2a7a9
title: get_environment_info does one recommended-event lookup per issue (bounded, best-effort)
description: get_environment_info calls get_recommended_event() for every issue while building the comment. This is a Snuba or nodestore query per issue (N+1), and each call is wrapped in a broad `except Exception` that only logs at info level, so real outages silently drop environment info.
failurePath: get_comment_body loops over up to 5 issues → one recommended-event lookup each → slow comment task; failures hidden at info level

head: ea188e2d736fd6ed27c1dba8aae63b7268e2a7a9
title: Error timestamps (seconds) compared with replay event timestamps (milliseconds)
description: Nodestore event timestamps are epoch seconds, while rrweb replay segment events carry millisecond timestamps. The chronological merge compares them directly, so every error sorts before all breadcrumbs. The tests use same-unit fake values and hide this.
failurePath: real replay segment with timestamp 1.7e12 and error timestamp 1.7e9 → error_events[idx].timestamp < event timestamp always true → all errors emitted first, ordering wrong
suggestion: Normalize units (multiply error timestamp by 1000 or divide event timestamp by 1000).

head: ea188e2d736fd6ed27c1dba8aae63b7268e2a7a9
title: HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES only applied when a search query is present
description: The early return `if (!searchQuery.trim()) return sorted;` happens before the HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES filter, so is_segment, project_id and received are shown by default and only disappear once the user types a search. The hidden list is therefore ineffective in the default view and the behaviour is inconsistent.
failurePath: open span drawer with empty search → early return sorted → hidden attributes rendered; type 'a' → they vanish
suggestion: Filter HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES first, then apply the search filter.

head: ea188e2d736fd6ed27c1dba8aae63b7268e2a7a9
title: Query key omits organization slug
description: The query key is ['use-trace-item-attribute-keys', queryOptions], where queryOptions holds only item type, attribute type, projects and datetime. The queryFn fetches from /organizations/${organization.slug}/trace-items/attributes/, so the org slug is an input missing from the key. After switching organizations in the same session, with the same project ids and datetime, the cache returns the previous org's attributes. The old code used the URL as the key, which included the slug. The old code also set staleTime 0, retry false and refetchOnWindowFocus false. These are now dropped, so default retry and focus-refetch behavior applies.
failurePath: Org A visited, then org B with same project ids/period → same query key → cached attributes of org A shown for org B.
suggestion: Include organization.slug in the queryKey, and restore retry: false / staleTime / refetchOnWindowFocus options if needed.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: Non-string backupCode crashes; no rate limiting on backup-code guessing
description: req.body.backupCode.replaceAll is called without type check; a non-string truthy value throws a 500. The endpoint also has no rate limiting for brute-forcing backup codes.

head: 54486a059cd2032042189bb565646ba4e0f6bd61
title: onEnable deferred to backup-codes Close button; dismissing dialog leaves parent stale
description: After a successful enable, onEnable() is no longer called; it is only called from the Close button. If the user dismisses the dialog via Escape/overlay (onOpenChange), the 2FA is enabled server-side but the parent never refreshes, the switch shows disabled, and the backup codes are lost (shown only once). Also form totpCode is not reset by resetState.
failurePath: Enter valid TOTP → step=DisplayBackupCodes → press Escape → onOpenChange only → onEnable never called → UI shows 2FA off while enabled
suggestion: Call onEnable when the totp is accepted (or on any close from the backup step) and reset the form in resetState.

head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
title: updateEvent calendar lookup compares against falsy externalCalendarId
description: In the else branch externalCalendarId is falsy, so `find(cal => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)` never matches a real calendar; selectedCalendar is undefined. Previously it fell back to event.destinationCalendar.externalId. Updates for references without externalCalendarId now fail or hit the wrong calendar.
failurePath: updateEvent without externalCalendarId → find matches nothing → calendarId undefined → Google update call fails
suggestion: Fall back to the main (first) destination calendar's externalId, e.g. filtered by credential.

head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
title: deleteEvent destination calendar fallback never matches
description: Same flawed find against falsy externalCalendarId: always undefined, so deletion falls back to "primary" instead of the booking's destination calendar as before; event on a non-primary calendar is not deleted (404 is swallowed as success).
failurePath: cancel booking with reference lacking externalCalendarId → calendarId undefined → delete on primary → 404 resolved silently → event remains

head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
title: Team destination calendars dropped when host has none
description: evt.destinationCalendar is null when neither eventType nor organizer has one; `?.push` then does nothing so collective team members' calendars are not used.
failurePath: collective event, organizer without destination calendar → destinationCalendar null → push skipped → team calendars ignored
suggestion: Initialize to [] and push unconditionally.

head: de628295646d0848226618108a52f2f1e5d04ac0
title: Recurring deletes repeated per calendar reference
description: The recurring branch deletes events for all updatedBookings across all calendar credentials, but it now runs inside a loop over every calendar reference, so with multiple references the same deletions are executed repeatedly (404/410 swallowed, but redundant API calls).
failurePath: recurring booking with N calendar references → N× full deletion sweeps

head: 92f44dcea7ff19e9123a30c63c167a2938df5a55
title: Error toast fallback never used and t() applied to raw messages
description: The message template string is always truthy, so `|| t("unable_to_add_guests")` is dead; non-translation server errors show as 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR: <raw>' and undefined code prints 'undefined: ...'.
failurePath: network error → err.data undefined → toast 'undefined: ...'

head: c790227e0cda780e6fea9bb03af27948d9e286b9
title: Unguarded retryCount update in catch can abort the whole reminder loop
description: The retryCount update in the catch block is not guarded. If the update itself fails (e.g., DB error, or the error came from the prior prisma update after Twilio already scheduled the SMS), the exception escapes the loop, the handler fails, and remaining reminders are not processed. Also, if the post-schedule DB update failed, retryCount is incremented and the SMS is rescheduled next run, causing duplicate SMS.
failurePath: twilio.scheduleSMS succeeds → prisma update throws → catch increments retryCount → next cron reschedules the same SMS (duplicate); or catch update throws → 500 and loop aborted
suggestion: Wrap the catch update in its own try/catch; separate scheduling errors from persistence errors.

head: da09bc0808e7c6df1bc10e00d5acf764d94c7cc7
title: Single eventType filter returned as unparenthesized OR fragment
description: With only an eventTypeId filter, buildFilterConditions returns `("eventTypeId" = X) OR ("eventParentId" = X)` with no outer parentheses. getBaseConditions wraps it, so the current path is safe. But a caller that uses getFilterConditions() directly and ANDs it with other SQL would get wrong precedence. That could widen results beyond the authorization scope.
suggestion: Wrap the OR in parentheses when building it.

head: 5fd11f9faa79c4aefd39975d1b0e963e5034f793
title: Failure paths exit with status 0
description: cleanup always runs `exit 0`, so the rate-limit and URL-extraction failures report success to callers.
failurePath: tmole fails to start → TUNNEL_URL empty → cleanup → exit 0
suggestion: Pass an exit code to cleanup and use exit 1 on failures.

head: 6048e2a86b50e81e1e3b1b467dfea5a895add3dc
title: Cron cancel loop aborts on the first failed SendGrid request, leaving later cancelled reminders uncancelled
description: The deleteMany of all EMAIL reminders with scheduledDate <= now runs first, then the cancelled lookup uses scheduledDate <= now+1h. Cancelled reminders whose date is already passed are deleted without cancelling the SendGrid batch. Also the cancel query lacks method filter (SMS reminders would be sent to SendGrid) and referenceId may be null (unscheduled ones are deleted directly, but guard missing). One failing request aborts the loop, leaving the rest uncancelled.

head: 6048e2a86b50e81e1e3b1b467dfea5a895add3dc
title: try/catch around fire-and-forget async calls is ineffective
description: deleteScheduledEmailReminder/SMS are async and not awaited, so the try/catch catches nothing (they swallow errors internally). Reschedule proceeds without waiting for cancellation; also with immediateDelete=true the DB rows are never removed, so stale reminders remain for the old booking.

head: 820d7fa87e0c824c5dee8082a33efadb1a2566f7
title: appStore dynamic imports start eagerly at module load, so the async import is not lazy
description: Each property is `import(...)` evaluated immediately when the object literal is built, so all ~30 app packages are loaded as soon as index.ts is imported, defeating the lazy-load intent. If any import rejects (missing env or dependency), that promise rejects with no handler unless that key is later awaited, which causes an unhandled rejection (fatal on Node 18).
failurePath: any module imports appStore -> object literal runs all import() calls -> an app module that fails to load rejects -> no handler attached -> unhandled rejection
suggestion: Make the values lazy thunks, e.g. `applecalendar: () => import("./applecalendar")`, and call and await them at the use sites.

head: ee38fd295fd294b9fc787eba482bde24bbfea69b
title: Override offset shift can wrap across midnight, producing end < start
description: override.timeZone is optional; tz(undefined) falls back to default/local zone, giving a wrong offset. Also adding the offset and taking hour/minute modulo 24h can wrap start/end across midnight (end < start), producing invalid timeframes. Offset is computed at override.start only, so DST changes between start and end are ignored.
failurePath: override with no timeZone → organizerUtcOffset uses server zone → shifted override times
suggestion: Skip the shift when timeZone is missing; handle day wrap.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: get_user_info exceptions not handled
description: get_user_info calls raise_for_status and does no other error handling. An invalid or expired token, a rate limit, or a network error raises an uncaught exception here, so the user gets a 500 and not the failure page. The token exchange just above is wrapped in try/except, so this call is inconsistent with it.
failurePath: GitHub /user returns 401/5xx → raise_for_status raises HTTPError → unhandled 500.
suggestion: Wrap in try/except and return error(...).

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: installation_id from query parameter can override/rebind state
description: A GET installation_id on the later step overrides the one bound in OAuth step; the sender check is tied to the integration looked up by that id, allowing the installation_id to be swapped after OAuth.

head: bb75657fc8f13923c1d7983f422290908a1e7310
title: redirect_uri not URL-encoded in authorize URL
description: redirect_uri is interpolated raw into the query string. Its own ':' and '/' characters, and any special characters in a customer-domain URL, are not percent-encoded. A redirect_uri containing '&' or '?' would corrupt the other parameters.
suggestion: Build the query with urllib.parse.urlencode.

head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f
title: Commit called from a background thread; stale offsets kept across rebalances
description: The commit function is invoked from a separate daemon thread, but Arroyo's commit callback is meant to be called from the consumer thread and is not thread-safe. The OffsetTracker is also never reset on rebalance, so offsets for revoked partitions may be committed later.

head: 9966ec5a13e331659c3ea00981f9b11b0faf821f
title: Commit stalls permanently on any offset gap
description: The contiguity check requires every offset between last_committed+1 and max to be in all_offsets. Legitimate gaps (compacted or transactional topics, offsets skipped after a rebalance rewind) are never filled. Committing stalls and all_offsets grows without bound. Offsets at or below last_committed after a re-delivery are also never committable.
failurePath: offset 101 never delivered (gap) → loop breaks at 101 → highest_committable never advances → no more commits and all_offsets grows
suggestion: Track committable position from the contiguous completed prefix of delivered offsets rather than assuming consecutive offsets, e.g. commit the minimum outstanding offset.

head: 8df850371034b73dc4dd9908cc30fa09f12a1f97
title: Pause/Restore/Export limited to alerting rules for Grafana prom rules
description: The ruler version enabled Pause, Restore, ModifyExport and DeletePermanently for all Grafana-managed rules, including recording rules. The prom version gates them on alertingRule, so Grafana recording rules lose pause/export in the list view.
failurePath: Grafana recording rule in list → isAlertingRule false → export/pause unsupported
suggestion: Use prometheusRuleType.grafana.rule(rule) for these gates; keep alertingRule only for Silence.

head: 8df850371034b73dc4dd9908cc30fa09f12a1f97
title: Federated rule groups no longer treated as immutable in useAllAlertRuleAbilities
description: The old code used isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group) for CombinedRule. The refactor delegates to useAllRulerRuleAbilities, which hardcodes isFederated = false. The deprecated hook still serves CombinedRule callers (e.g. RuleActionsButtons, RuleDetails), so federated Mimir/Loki rules now get edit/delete/pause abilities enabled.
failurePath: CombinedRule from federated group → useAllAlertRuleAbilities → isFederated false → Update/Delete supported
suggestion: Pass the federated flag through from CombinedRule.group into the shared implementation.

head: 8df850371034b73dc4dd9908cc30fa09f12a1f97
title: Silence is a no-op and Delete is unavailable for prom-only Grafana rules in the list view
description: For list-view rules, rule (ruler) is undefined: the silence drawer only renders when rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) so 'Silence notifications' menu item does nothing; and handleDelete in AlertRuleMenu requires rulerRule, so Delete likely does nothing for prom-only rules. Menu entries are enabled by Grafana abilities but actions are no-ops.

head: 303cdc2caf256aa5df660611120c2e3f7392365d
title: FromContext silently drops context when type assertion fails
description: If the infra logger's FromContext returns something other than *log.ConcreteLogger, the wrapper falls back to d.New(), discarding the contextual attributes (plugin id, endpoint, ds name, etc.) and the log line loses them without any signal.

head: 04cfa3bfd469c035ff8b35f9a66867c4e8d5dcf4
title: Bind-parameter limit only handled for SQLite; batch size can exceed limits elsewhere
description: With the new IN (?,?,...) delete, any batch size above the driver's limit (65535 for Postgres/MySQL) now fails, whereas the previous single-statement subquery had no parameter limit. Only SQLite with batch>999 is special-cased. Also the SQLite decision is based on configured batch size rather than len(ids), which is fine but inlines IDs unnecessarily.
failurePath: AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize configured >65535 on Postgres/MySQL → fetchIDs returns >65535 ids → DELETE with too many placeholders errors → cleanup never succeeds.
suggestion: Chunk deletes into groups under the parameter limit for all dialects.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Async legacy write uses request context that is cancelled when handler returns
description: The goroutine derives its timeout context from the request ctx. Once the handler returns, the request context is cancelled, so the legacy write is often cancelled or fails, losing legacy writes (data divergence). Same in Update, Delete and DeleteCollection goroutines.
failurePath: client POST → Storage.Create succeeds → handler returns, request ctx cancelled → goroutine's Legacy.Create runs with cancelled ctx → fails/aborts, legacy store never gets the object
suggestion: Use context.WithoutCancel(ctx) as parent before WithTimeoutCause.

head: e369f24665ec70e1e3700f457d25ef83301d931a
title: Storage failure recorded as legacy duration
description: On Storage.Create/Update error, recordLegacyDuration is called instead of recordStorageDuration, polluting legacy metrics and omitting storage error metrics.
failurePath: Storage.Create returns error → recordLegacyDuration(true,...) → storage error metric missing, legacy metric wrong
suggestion: Use recordStorageDuration.

head: e944e2acf1e64421860a8e827f93ad06c169621b
title: remove() always queries the DB for the IDP; null-IDP NPE only in the already-invalid branch (existing behaviour)
description: idpDelegate.getByAlias(alias) is now run on every remove, even when the alias is cached and not invalidated, which adds a DB query. If the alias does not exist, storedIdp is null, and registerIDPInvalidation(storedIdp) NPEs in the invalid branch instead of remove returning false.
failurePath: remove(unknownAlias) while the alias key is already invalidated → storedIdp null → registerIDPInvalidation(null) → NPE
suggestion: Fetch the IDP only where needed and null-check it before invalidating.

head: 7355f05e6aafe2a7acc6434fb40c686665416606
title: Possible NPE when the Groups resource-type resource is missing
description: getResourceTypeResource can return null, for example when the schema is unsupported or the resource is missing. Its result is then passed to policyStore.findByResource and dereferenced without a null check.

head: ce2dcc537b4b1f98a335e88cfe8e0b804483252a
title: getCredentials dereferences possibly-null MyUser
description: getMyUser(user) returns null when the user is not in the in-memory map (e.g. removed or a different federated user). The other methods (getDisableableCredentialTypesStream, isConfiguredFor, isValid) null-check; getCredentials does not and throws NPE on myUser.recoveryCodes.
failurePath: user id not in users map → credentialManager().getFederatedCredentialsStream() → getCredentials → myUser.recoveryCodes → NPE
suggestion: Return Stream.empty() if myUser == null.

head: 4def149a50c4b9b2c24fbb753ac60fe4f4df0cac
title: Other getSubGroupsStream overloads still NPE when group deleted concurrently
description: getSubGroupsCount was made null-safe for a concurrently deleted group (modelSupplier.get() returns null), but the sibling getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference modelSupplier.get() directly and throw NPE in the same race.
failurePath: group deleted concurrently while cached adapter is in use, getGroupModel returns null, modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...) throws NullPointerException
suggestion: Return Stream.empty() when the model is null.
